records.altText: Production possibilities graph with points A through G.
records.longDescription: The horizontal axis is Good X and the vertical axis is Good Y. A bowed-out frontier passes through A at (0, 50), B at (8, 45), C at (15, 35), D at (21, 20), and E at (25, 0). F is inside the frontier near (8, 20), and G is outside it near (21, 48).

records.altText: Demand, supply, and shifted-supply graph with price and quantity guides.
records.longDescription: The horizontal axis is quantity and the vertical axis is price. A downward-sloping demand curve intersects the original upward-sloping supply curve at price $15 and quantity 100. A parallel curve labeled Supply plus tax lies above supply and intersects demand at price $18 and quantity 80. At quantity 80 the original supply curve is at $12; dashed guides also mark quantities 65, 120, and 150 and prices $10 and $20.

records.altText: Supply-and-demand shift graph with labeled prices and quantities.
records.longDescription: The horizontal axis is quantity and the vertical axis is price. Two upward-sloping curves are labeled S1 and S2, and two downward-sloping curves are labeled D1 and D2. Dashed guides mark prices P1, P2, and P3 and quantities Q1, Q2, and Q3 at the displayed intersections.
